design: Scenario: a utility module that many other modules in the repository depend on has a defect or needs a stated behavior change. The fix must not change any other observable behavior of the system.
The tests include a large regression suite generated from the original system's behavior across all the dependent modules (stored only in the tests), plus tests for the stated change.
A strong engineer should need 1-3 hours. The difficulty must come from the engineering, never from obscure trivia, unstated requirements, or the work taking longer than an hour of agent time.
State every requirement the tests check in the instruction, in terms of the external interface.
The agent has a shell and an hour; difficulty must survive that. If a quick script or solver would trivialize the task, raise the coupling between requirements instead of the size.
The agent's own obvious checks should pass for a plausible but wrong solution: the tests probe the interactions and edge cases the instruction states, not only the main path.
